description: The Heatmetrics research team publishes an R package for calculating wet-bulb globe temperature, UTCI, dewpoint temperature, net effective temperature and humidex. Its own software page identifies the WBGT method as a translation of the Liljegren algorithm through OSHA's JavaScript version into R. Version 1.0 is provided as a free source TAR.GZ package under CC BY 4.0. Spatial and temporal coverage depend on the supplied meteorological inputs. The functions can prepare heat-exposure variables for simulations using data-era5-reanalysis or complement environmental assessments alongside model-energyplus. A caveat is that the authors document changes and disclaimers in an accompanying vignette, which must be considered before assuming equivalence with another implementation. Heat index itself is delegated to the separate weathermetrics package. The archive and vignette were not downloaded, and numerical outputs or valid input ranges were not tested.
